actual.titulo: Secrets of the Universe • SLS: NASA's Mega Rocket
actual.descripcion: SLS: NASA's Mega Rocket ׀ NASA's Space Launch System is the most powerful rocket ever built; this is the story of the incredible engineering that went into building it, told first-hand by NASA's best rocket engineers.

siguiente.titulo: Space Greed • Sol Ownership: Can a Corporation Own the Sun?
siguiente.descripcion: Sol Ownership: Can a Corporation Own the Sun? ׀ Human needs have always created opportunities for human greed; energy might be the most crucial need of all; if, one day, an ambitious corporation was able to control the sun, could there end up being a subscription fee for sunlight.

lista.titulo: Space Greed • Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It?
lista.descripcion: Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It? ׀ There are only a handful of rocket launches every year, but that could change; each rocket that gets fired off has an impact on the atmosphere; Earth may not be able to survive hundreds, or even thousands, of fuel-burning rocket launches every year.

lista.titulo: Space Greed • Looting the Moon for Trillions of Dollars
lista.descripcion: Looting the Moon for Trillions of Dollars ׀ The moon is rich in rare earths, metals, and the highly sought-after isotope Helium 3; with NASA planning to make a manned return trip to the moon by 2024, some giant corporation could turn moon dust into a cosmic-sized payday.
